title: sdk(ts): surface model changelog URL + add typed Model Metadata v1 structures
author: Ibrahim Khan
description:
Summary: This PR updates the TS SDK to (1) pass through the resolved model version and the published changelog URL when present, and (2) introduce typed structures for Model Metadata Schema v1 so callers can safely consume metadata returned by the control plane / feed endpoints.

Motivation: Customers are asking for immutable, customer-visible model release notes and want the SDK to expose the resolved version (especially when pinning / during rollouts). The platform work is landing changelog publishing + feed endpoints; this SDK change makes that data available without requiring customers to parse headers manually.

What changed: - Adds new exported types for Model Metadata Schema v1: ModelRecordV1, ModelVersionRecordV1, ModelProvenanceV1, ModelCompatibilityV1, DeprecationV1, QuantizationProfileV1 (in `src/types/model_metadata_v1.ts`). - Introduces a small, namespaced "redwood" metadata object on responses that includes `modelVersion` and `changelogUrl` when available. - For OpenAI-compatible routes, reads passthrough values from response headers when the server does not include explicit JSON fields (aligns with redwood-openai-compat#412): `x-redwood-model-version` and `x-redwood-changelog-url`. - Updates generated client types so these fields are visible in the returned objects (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank).

Minor breaking change (migration note): We previously exposed an undocumented `response.changelogUrl` (flat) in a couple of internal examples and a beta build; this is now standardized under `response.redwood.changelogUrl`. If you were depending on the flat field, update to: `resp.redwood?.changelogUrl`. Also, `ModelMetadata` has been renamed to `ModelRecordV1` to avoid ambiguity as we introduce schema versions; any imports of `ModelMetadata` should be updated.

Example: const resp = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: "llama-3.1-70b", messages }); console.log(resp.redwood?.modelVersion); // e.g. "llama-3.1-70b@2026-02-18" console.log(resp.redwood?.changelogUrl); // e.g. "https://docs.redwoodinference.com/model-release-notes/llama-3.1-70b#2026-02-18"

Notes / constraints: - This intentionally does not attempt to render release notes or fetch the changelog feed from the SDK; it only surfaces links/identifiers returned by the API. - `changelogUrl` is treated as an opaque string. We do not validate domains to avoid breaking Private deployments where docs may be hosted internally.

Testing: - Added unit tests for header passthrough behavior + nullability (`tests/redwood_metadata_headers.test.ts`). - Typecheck + lint + build in CI.

Release: Patch release (0.27.4). Changelog entry included below.
commits: sdk(ts): add Model Metadata v1 types and exports
sdk(ts): passthrough x-redwood-model-version and x-redwood-changelog-url headers
tests: add coverage for header parsing + null behavior
docs: update README examples and migration note
review_conversation: Monica Patel: Can we confirm the naming for the header keys and ensure we don’t diverge from the control plane / compat layer?
Ibrahim Khan: Yep — aligned with redwood-openai-compat#412 (`x-redwood-model-version`, `x-redwood-changelog-url`). Added constants + tests to lock this down.
Brian Murphy: Suggest keeping this namespaced to avoid polluting the OpenAI response surface. `response.redwood` looks good. Can we make it optional and avoid breaking existing response typings?
Ibrahim Khan: Done — `redwood?: { modelVersion?: string; changelogUrl?: string }` and no required fields added. Updated type tests.
Wei Chen: Please add a short migration note for customers who used the old flat property name from the beta example. Also confirm we’re not linking to internal-only URLs.
Ibrahim Khan: Added README migration note and clarified that URL is opaque / may be internal for Private deployments.
Chloe Martin: Any concern about caching/proxies stripping custom headers?
Ibrahim Khan: If headers are missing, fields remain undefined; server-side will also include JSON fields for console/control-plane endpoints. Documented behavior in code comment.
Monica Patel: Approved. Please include a patch-level release note entry.
Ibrahim Khan: Added `release_notes` field below + will cut 0.27.4 after merge.
release_notes: TS SDK now exposes `response.redwood.modelVersion` and `response.redwood.changelogUrl` when available, and exports typed Model Metadata Schema v1 structures for consumers. Minor breaking change: `response.changelogUrl` (beta/undocumented) has been moved to `response.redwood.changelogUrl`, and `ModelMetadata` type has been renamed to `ModelRecordV1`.
